summary: Forcepoint secure web gateway (SWG) in the cloud, hybrid or on-prem: filters sites by category and reputation, inspects web pages and files in real time and controls the use of cloud and AI services.
value: Malicious, phishing and unwanted sites are blocked — both in the office and for remote workers.
New malicious pages not yet on any list are inspected when opened.
You can see which unsanctioned cloud and AI services employees use, and restrict them.
Access to sites and social networks is configured by group, time and quota.
simple: Forcepoint Web Security is a secure web gateway (SWG) deployed in the cloud, on-prem (Content Gateway on an appliance or virtual machine) or hybrid (management in the office, inspection in the cloud for branches and remote workers; agent on the device). It filters sites using a URL category database and reputation, decrypts and inspects HTTPS, and the ACE (Advanced Classification Engine) analyzes page content, scripts, links and files in real time (antivirus, heuristics, reputation) — including for unknown sites. It shows and blocks unsanctioned cloud and AI applications and provides granular access rules (social networks, quotas, geo-restrictions). Licensed per user.
notIncluded: No file sandbox — that is the Advanced Malware Detection and Protection (AMDP) add-on.
Remote browser isolation (RBI) is included only in cloud deployment and only for uncategorized sites; for the rest, separate Selective / Full Isolation licenses.
No full DLP — the Web DLP Module or Forcepoint DLP are added separately.
No full CASB for cloud applications — a separate product.
classification: URL database, categories, reputation and ACE (real-time analysis of new pages) — web filtering; we did not find dedicated inline inspection of phishing pages or protection against password entry — no browser protection.
AMDP (sandbox), RBI with CDR, DLP module, CASB are add-ons according to the brochure, not counted as classes.
Gateway antivirus is part of web protection, not counted as a separate class.
Standard Compliance DLP is an add-on in on-prem and hybrid deployments, its scope in the cloud is not confirmed — no DLP.
